intent: Clear the last six over-cap test modules in python_pkg, all in wsg_grabber, finishing the package tree.
scope: Non-goal: no assertion changed, no test deleted, skipped or weakened
changes: Partitioned all six at topic boundaries, in two passes: the first cut left five files still over, so each was cut again. Eleven new modules, named for the behaviour they cover rather than a partN suffix.

Each split copies the entire original preamble - imports, local mock builders and the module's pytest fixtures - into the new file. Carrying the fixtures matters more here than in other packages: test_player, test_ui and test_app each define module-scoped fixtures (started, toolkit, session) that their tests take as parameters, and pytest resolves those lexically within the module.
conftest.py's autouse isolate_paths fixture still applies to every new module unchanged, since they all sit in the same directory.
No patch string changed. The wsg_grabber source was split under the cap in earlier sessions, so every patched name already resolves on the module each test file names.

verification.command: timeout 180 env PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest python_pkg/wsg_grabber/tests -q
verification.evidence: 277 passed before the split and 277 passed after both passes - identical count. Verified after each of the two rounds, not just at the end.
No output at all: every file under python_pkg is now within the 250-line cap, down from 50 violations when this effort started and 13 at the beginning of this session's python_pkg work.

verification.command: pre-commit run --files <the touched test files and artifacts>
verification.evidence: ruff pruned 82 imports the preamble copy left unused across the eleven new modules and reformatted 14 files; clean on re-run, with mypy, pylint, name-tests-test and pytest-with-coverage all passing at 100%.

risks: Copying a preamble that defines pytest fixtures duplicates those fixture definitions across the split halves. That is harmless while both halves use them, but a later edit that removes the last user in one half leaves a dead fixture ruff will not flag, since a fixture is referenced by name rather than imported.
test_net.py landed at exactly 250 lines - at the cap, not under it by any margin. A single added line there will trip the gate.
rollback: git revert the commit; the six originals return at their previous sizes and the eleven new modules disappear.
After rollback, re-run the package suite and confirm it still reports 277 passed.
